bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the news-summary workflow and wrote regression tests with pytest for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out document groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.
Under supervision, joined news-summary document identifiers to publication metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
Under supervision, wrote Python functions for parsing the provided product review records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, applied a documented topic dictionary to product review document samples using NLTK and checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.
Under supervision, joined review document identifiers to product metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
